note: Triennial election of the Downpatrick rural district council (twenty-two divisions), 1924; polling day for Co. Down, Thursday 5 June 1924. Unionists were unopposed in twenty divisions; Ardglass and Seaforde had Sinn Féin nominees, who withdrew under the Nationalist abstention policy, so there was no contest anywhere (Belfast News-Letter, 8 May 1924, p. 5; Newry Reporter, 20 May 1924, p. 8). Only these two divisions are named in the reports found. Mr. John Woods (S.F.) was nominated and withdrew. Returned unopposed.
